coordinateSystem: Native grid XYZ, Z up, blueprint block indices; the cell is the top cell, a column stands in the cell above
rule: Top cells (occupied, nothing occupied above in the blueprint); inner box = samples 2..5 of 8 per axis; blocked = static geometry from 0.1 over the cell top up one layer (vertical and horizontal rays); covered = static geometry anywhere above that; animated = animated geometry in the top cell or the cell above
